title: Single violation: buying power exceeded
notes: Cash account. cash and buying_power are both 5000.00; equity is 60000.00 because the account also holds VTI (110 sh @ 500.00 = 55000.00, long held, untouched by this basket) -- that position exists purely to keep the concentration cap out of this test: cap is 15% of 60000.00 = 9000.00, and the 8000.00 TSLA buy (8000/60000 = 13.3%) would fit under it even at full size, so R3 never fires and this stays a true single-rule case. Basket notional is 8000.00, exceeding buying_power by 3000.00. R1 is BLOCKING; there is no well-defined auto-resize for a buying-power shortfall (unlike a concentration cap, there's no user-specified target to round down to), so the basket BLOCKs rather than being silently resized -- the trader must resubmit with a smaller amount. Zero orders reach the broker.
